Dark forged plate grain with meteor-like cold-blue vein inclusions establishes skyiron beyond palette alone.
Emission remains confined to sparse narrow blue veins; the plates and overall armour do not become a full-object glow.
Premium realistic painterly finish, honest plate wear, cold key light, restrained warm rim, midnight-charcoal ground, floor plane, and grounded assembly match the accepted profile.
